name: Women's USAF-style mess dress: general officer sleeve braid overlay (1 1/2 in, 3 in from the sleeve end)
size_basis: Same artwork box and scale as garment-mess-dress-female. Braid 1.5 in wide per CAPR 39-1 4.1.2.1 (the sleeve end is 2.5 in below its lower edge). Braid tone sampled from CAPR 39-1 (3 Mar 2020) rendered at 3x: Fig 4.6 PDF p64 (p.36) braid 2.3,33.1,86.2 / 2.7,31.9,84.3; Fig 4.1 PDF p54 (p.26) 2.1,32.3,83.6; Fig 4.7a PDF p73 (p.45) 2.1,32.4,84.6; coat 0,40,101. Drawn as 0.04 in lines on a 0.1 in pitch, tones = coat navy x RATIO.
landmarks_note: polygons are [[x,y]...] in user units (0.01 in)
documented: 1 1/2 in blue sleeve braid for general officers (4.1.1.1 / 4.1.2.1)
assumed: braid colour: not specified as a shade; tone sampled from the CAPR 39-1 figures 4.1 / 4.6 (see base-art/braid-art.js)
1 1/2 in braid edge nearest the sleeve end set at the same distance as the 1/2 in braid
